[[File:TIPH.jpg|thumb|right|The cover of ''The Imperial Pilot's Handbook''.]]
'''''The Imperial Pilot's Handbook''''' was an introductory [[Hologram disc/Legends|holodisc]] document given to new [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The document gave an overview of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] systems and basic tactics.
